workflow.name: Docker Management Bot via Telegram
workflow.description: Monitors Docker containers via Uptime Kuma webhooks and enables Telegram-based management: AI log analysis, container restart, status check, and Docker image updates via SSH commands.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI GPT used to analyze Docker container logs

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API endpoint

MODEL.description: LLM model name for log analysis

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token (mocked in this project)

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Telegram chat ID for sending messages (mocked)

SSH_HOST.description: Remote server IP/hostname for SSH Docker commands (mocked)

workflow_steps.name: Receive Uptime Kuma Webhook
workflow_steps.description: Receive heartbeat webhook from Uptime Kuma monitoring tool with container status

workflow_steps.name: Check Heartbeat Status
workflow_steps.description: Route by heartbeat message: 'running' → OK, anything else → ERROR alert

workflow_steps.name: Send OK Notification
workflow_steps.description: Send 'service is running' OK message to Telegram

workflow_steps.name: Send Error Notification
workflow_steps.description: Send error alert to Telegram with quick-action keyboard (Logs / Restart buttons)

workflow_steps.name: Send Analyzing Status
workflow_steps.description: Notify user 'Analyzing Log File...' while AI processes the logs

workflow_steps.name: Analyze Logs with AI
workflow_steps.description: GPT acts as senior IT specialist to analyze logs and provide structured diagnosis

workflow_steps.name: Send Restart Message
workflow_steps.description: Notify user 'Attempting to restart...' before executing restart

workflow_steps.name: Send Docker Status
workflow_steps.description: Send formatted docker ps output to Telegram user

workflow_steps.name: Send Update Started
workflow_steps.description: Notify user 'Running Update...' before executing docker update script

workflow_steps.name: Send Update Result
workflow_steps.description: Send formatted update summary to Telegram user
